notes: Truth manifest for the cmux iOS App Store screenshot set. SnapshotUITests captures the sources deterministically from in-app preview fixtures; ios/scripts/appstore-shots.sh post-processes captures to these exact ASC pixel sizes, stages final/<DISPLAY_TYPE>/, verifies, and uploads. ASC allows at most 10 screenshots per display type.

APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129.notes: Portrait full-bleed. The live listing's page 1 is a sidebar+session split; the preview fixtures cannot render that split yet (workspace-list preview pushes a plain fixture detail), so the workspaces list stands in until a split preview exists.

APP_IPAD_PRO_129.notes: Marketing-framed portrait pages for the legacy 12.9-inch slot, composed from the iPad captures with the frame_assets backgrounds (same composition as compose_shots.py). simctl cannot rotate a simulator, so these embed portrait captures; the retired live pair embedded landscape.
